units.text: INT. DISUSED FUNICULAR CAR - NIGHT
A wooden car stalled halfway up a mountain track, lights guttering.
Outside, black pines and a vertical drop.
Inside, four people, a thermos, and a briefcase handcuffed to someone's wrist.
AGENT CLEMENTINE ROUX (40s, trench coat, the kind of face that gives nothing away) grips the briefcase handle.
Across from her sits RODION VASILYEV (50s, fur collar, a gold tooth catching the light).
Beside her, a young porter, FELIX (20s, uniform two sizes too big), shakes.
At the rear window, a woman named SABINE HOLT (30s, driver's gloves, bruised lip) watches the track below.
Nobody touches the emergency brake.
units.name: CLEMENTINE

units.text: It is already stuck.
units.name: RODION

units.text: The cable's frayed. I told the foreman. I told him twice.
units.name: FELIX

units.text: Of course you did.
units.name: SABINE

units.text: Felix, how long until the next car?
units.name: CLEMENTINE

units.text: There isn't one. We're the last run.
units.name: FELIX

units.text: Then we wait.
units.name: RODION

units.text: We don't wait. Someone in this car cut that cable.
units.name: CLEMENTINE

units.text: Sabine turns.
Rodion leans forward.
Felix presses against the wall.
You accuse us?
units.name: RODION

units.text: I accuse the cable.
units.name: CLEMENTINE

units.text: She is right.
units.name: SABINE

units.text: Felix lunges for the door handle.
Rodion catches his collar.
Sabine grabs Rodion's wrist.
The briefcase swings on its chain.
Clementine slams it against the window, glass cracking, cold air hissing through.
For a moment, all four are tangled.
Then the car lurches.
Everyone freezes.
The sound of a single strand parting, far above.
Nobody breathe.
units.name: CLEMENTINE

units.text: Rodion lets go of Felix.
Sabine lets go of Rodion.
Slowly, painfully, they all sit down.
I told Anton we should have taken the road.
units.name: RODION

units.text: Outside, wind.
Inside, the thermos rolls across the floor and stops against Felix's boot.
